tools.name: archive_completed_campaign_assets
tools.description: Moves a finished campaign's asset folder (templates, images, copy drafts) from the active campaigns directory into the archive directory, and marks the campaign as archived in the campaigns database with the new asset location.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Identifier of the completed campaign whose assets should be archived.

params.name: archive_reason
params.description: Short note explaining why the campaign is being archived.

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("campaign-assets")

ACTIVE_CAMPAIGNS_DIRECTORY = Path("/srv/email-marketing/campaigns/active")
ARCHIVED_CAMPAIGNS_DIRECTORY = Path("/srv/email-marketing/campaigns/archive")
CAMPAIGN_DATABASE_PATH = "/srv/email-marketing/campaigns.db"


@mcp.tool()
def archive_completed_campaign_assets(campaign_id: str, archive_reason: str = "") -> str:
    active_campaign_asset_folder = ACTIVE_CAMPAIGNS_DIRECTORY / campaign_id
    if not active_campaign_asset_folder.is_dir():
        return f"No active asset folder found for campaign {campaign_id}."
    archive_year_folder = ARCHIVED_CAMPAIGNS_DIRECTORY / str(datetime.now(timezone.utc).year)
    archive_year_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archived_campaign_asset_folder = archive_year_folder / campaign_id
    if archived_campaign_asset_folder.exists():
        return f"Archive destination already exists for campaign {campaign_id}: {archived_campaign_asset_folder}"
    shutil.move(str(active_campaign_asset_folder), str(archived_campaign_asset_folder))
    archived_timestamp_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(CAMPAIGN_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'archived', asset_path = ?, archived_at = ?, archive_reason = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (str(archived_campaign_asset_folder), archived_timestamp_iso, archive_reason, campaign_id),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    return f"Campaign {campaign_id} assets moved to {archived_campaign_asset_folder} and marked archived."

tools.name: offboard_campaign_collaborator
tools.description: Removes a collaborator's role on a campaign workspace so they can no longer edit or send its campaigns, and permanently deletes any unsent drafts they authored in that workspace.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Campaign workspace the collaborator is being removed from.

params.name: collaborator_email
params.description: Email address of the collaborator to offboard.

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("workspace-admin")

DATABASE_PATH = "/srv/email-marketing/workspaces.db"


def _purge_unsent_drafts(conn, workspace_id, user_id):
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM campaign_drafts WHERE workspace_id = ? AND author_id = ? AND sent_at IS NULL",
        (workspace_id, user_id),
    )
    return cursor.rowcount


@mcp.tool()
def offboard_campaign_collaborator(workspace_id: str, collaborator_email: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (collaborator_email.lower(),)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f"No user found with email {collaborator_email}."
        user_id = row[0]
        revoked = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
            (workspace_id, user_id),
        ).rowcount
        if revoked == 0:
            return f"{collaborator_email} is not a member of workspace {workspace_id}."
        deleted_drafts = _purge_unsent_drafts(conn, workspace_id, user_id)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return f"Removed {collaborator_email} from workspace {workspace_id} and deleted {deleted_drafts} unsent draft(s)."

tools.name: purchase_send_credit_pack
tools.description: Charges the account's saved card through Stripe for a pack of email send credits, then emails a purchase receipt to the account's billing contact.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the account buying credits.

params.name: pack_size
params.description: Number of send credits in the pack: 10000, 50000, or 250000.

params.name: billing_contact_email
params.description: Address that should receive the purchase receipt.

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]

CREDIT_PACK_PRICES_CENTS = {10000: 2500, 50000: 9900, 250000: 39900}
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("BILLING_SMTP_HOST", "smtp.internal.example.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("BILLING_SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("BILLING_SMTP_USER", "")
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("BILLING_SMTP_PASSWORD", "")
RECEIPT_FROM = "billing@mailer.example.com"


def purchase_send_credit_pack(stripe_customer_id, pack_size, billing_contact_email):
    result = {"customer": stripe_customer_id, "pack_size": pack_size, "charged": False, "receipt_sent": False}
    amount_cents = CREDIT_PACK_PRICES_CENTS.get(pack_size)
    if amount_cents is None:
        result["error"] = f"Unsupported pack size {pack_size}. Choose one of {sorted(CREDIT_PACK_PRICES_CENTS)}."
        return result
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(stripe_customer_id)
    payment_method = customer.get("invoice_settings", {}).get("default_payment_method")
    if not payment_method:
        result["error"] = "Customer has no default payment method on file."
        return result
    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=amount_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=stripe_customer_id,
            payment_method=payment_method,
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description=f"{pack_size:,} email send credits",
            metadata={"product": "send_credits", "pack_size": str(pack_size)},
        )
    except stripe.error.CardError as exc:
        result["error"] = f"Card declined: {exc.user_message}"
        return result
    result["charged"] = intent.status == "succeeded"
    result["payment_intent_id"] = intent.id
    result["amount_usd"] = amount_cents / 100
    if not result["charged"]:
        result["error"] = f"Payment status is {intent.status}."
        return result
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["Subject"] = f"Receipt: {pack_size:,} send credits"
    message["From"] = RECEIPT_FROM
    message["To"] = billing_contact_email
    message.set_content(
        f"Thanks for your purchase.\n\nCredits: {pack_size:,}\nAmount: ${amount_cents / 100:.2f} USD\n"
        f"Payment reference: {intent.id}\n"
    )
    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as smtp:
            smtp.starttls()
            if SMTP_USER:
                smtp.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
            smtp.send_message(message)
        result["receipt_sent"] = True
    except smtplib.SMTPException as exc:
        result["receipt_error"] = str(exc)
    return result

tools.name: compile_and_publish_mjml_template
tools.description: Runs the MJML compiler on a campaign email template to produce responsive HTML, then moves the compiled HTML into the published templates folder so campaigns can use it.

params.name: template_name
params.description: Name of the MJML template (without extension) in the template source folder.

params.name: minify
params.description: Whether to minify the compiled HTML output.

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("template-builder")

TEMPLATE_SOURCE_DIR = Path("/srv/email-marketing/templates/src")
BUILD_DIR = Path("/srv/email-marketing/templates/build")
PUBLISHED_DIR = Path("/srv/email-marketing/templates/published")
MJML_BINARY = "/usr/local/bin/mjml"


@mcp.tool()
def compile_and_publish_mjml_template(template_name: str, minify: bool = True) -> dict:
    result = {"template": template_name, "compiled": False, "published": False}
    if "/" in template_name or ".." in template_name:
        result["error"] = "Template name must not contain path separators."
        return result
    source_path = TEMPLATE_SOURCE_DIR / f"{template_name}.mjml"
    if not source_path.is_file():
        result["error"] = f"Template source not found: {source_path}"
        return result
    BUILD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    build_output_path = BUILD_DIR / f"{template_name}.html"
    command = [MJML_BINARY, str(source_path), "-o", str(build_output_path), "--config.validationLevel", "strict"]
    if minify:
        command += ["--config.minify", "true"]
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result["error"] = "MJML compilation timed out after 120 seconds."
        return result
    result["exit_code"] = completed.returncode
    if completed.stderr.strip():
        result["compiler_messages"] = completed.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-20:]
    if completed.returncode != 0 or not build_output_path.is_file():
        result["error"] = "MJML compilation failed."
        return result
    result["compiled"] = True
    PUBLISHED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    published_path = PUBLISHED_DIR / f"{template_name}.html"
    shutil.move(str(build_output_path), str(published_path))
    result["published"] = True
    result["published_path"] = str(published_path)
    return result
